caseName: Aristeguieta v. First National Bank of New York
caseNameFull: ARISTEGUIETA, CONSUL GENERAL OF THE REPUBLIC OF VENEZUELA, v. FIRST NATIONAL BANK OF NEW YORK Et Al.
attorneys: Howard C. Westwood for petitioner., John A. Wilson, Alexis C. Coudert and Melber Chambers for respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to vacate the judgment is granted. The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded to the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida with instructions to dismiss the cause as moot.

Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
